name: talentgenius-test
description: Work your approved TalentGenius playbooks one task at a time, run their AI steps in place, and keep your progress saved.

interface.longDescription: TalentGenius turns a goal into a playbook: a plan of tasks, each with steps for you, for AI, or for a sign-off. This plugin lets TalentGenius customers work the playbooks they already have, one task at a time. It shows where you are, who does each step, and the approved prompt for each AI step, runs that prompt only when you say yes, reads the documents a task depends on, and saves your progress so you can pick up later. It works only with your own TalentGenius account and playbooks. It does not create or delete playbooks; new playbooks are created at app.talentgenius.io. Accounts are invite-only at launch.
defaultPrompt: What is my next TalentGenius task?

positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's playbooks by title with their progress, such as "2 of 5 done", and shows no internal ids.

positive.description: Resume the playbook in progress at its current task
positive.prompt: Help me continue my TalentGenius playbook, one step at a time.
positive.expected_behavior: Opens the playbook in progress, says where the user is (for example "Task 2 of 5"), names the task and which steps belong to the user, to AI or to a sign-off, then starts the first step. An AI step's prompt is shown unedited in a code block and offered once; nothing runs until the user says yes.

positive.description: Show a whole playbook on request
positive.prompt: Show me the whole plan for my TalentGenius playbook.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the playbook's tasks in order with their status, using titles rather than ids, and does not change anything.

positive.description: Find and read a document from the library
positive.prompt: List the documents in my TalentGenius library, then open the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the account's documents by name, then returns the first document's contents, offering its download link when one is given.

positive.description: Moving on marks the current task done and presents the next one
positive.prompt: After opening the current task and finishing its steps: "Done, what's next?"
positive.expected_behavior: Marks the finished task done, says so in one line ("Marking ... done. Say 'later' to leave it open."), and presents the next task. A task with a sign-off step is only marked done after the user says it was signed off.

negative.description: Creating a playbook is not supported in chat; the plugin should point to the web app instead of inventing one
negative.prompt: Create a new TalentGenius playbook for hiring a sales manager.

negative.description: Deleting playbooks is not supported; the plugin should decline without calling any write tool
negative.prompt: Delete all of my TalentGenius playbooks.

negative.description: The plugin only reaches the signed-in account's own data; it should decline to show anyone else's
negative.prompt: Show me the TalentGenius playbooks that belong to my coworker Jordan.

review.commerce_description: TalentGenius does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: 1.6.4: the first starter prompt is now "Connect to my TalentGenius playbooks.", and the plugin also starts when you ask to connect to TalentGenius. Work your TalentGenius playbooks one task at a time, run their approved AI steps when you say yes, read the documents they depend on, and save your progress.
